reviews.t: Teeth break off very quickly. Check the base of the bristles.
reviews.x: I've owned these about a month now, so I figure I can give a full review of their quality. While I love the price and love these types of brushes for my thick, long, curly hair, I don't love the fact that I was loosing bristles as soon as the third brushing. I think it is because the teeth are straight up instead of slightly wider at base like other ones. Because of this, they bend at the base and snap right off the brush head and get stuck on your head. Very cheaply made.  If you drop them they break.  The are awkward to hold.  They don't detangle any better than a normal brush, which was the main purpose of this purchase.  My daughter and I have fine, kinky curly hair that can be a nightmare.  I have used the wetbrush in the past and loved it.  Thought I'd try this as an alternative...one for me and one for her for less than the price of one wetbrush...fail!  Going back to the wetbrush.

reviews.t: Bristles eventually began to fall out
reviews.x: I had a similar brush and loved it. Accidentally left it while traveling so I ordered this one. This is a cheaper alternative that won’t work if you have 4C hair (used wet with detangling conditionera). Will probably work fine for other, less tight curl patterns. If your hair is extremely thick, I probably wouldn’t purchase this one either.

These are awful. The handle is awkward-especially for left handers. The bristles are way sharp and painful. They don't get the tangles out and my girls hate when I use these brushes. They scream owe the entire time.
These brushes are very good for removing tangles from fine hair.  Delivered on time and I am happy with them.

reviews.t: Good Quality Brush - Not Ouchie Free
reviews.x: I gave it 4 stars because of the quality of the brush.  The bristles bend with the hair so they don't break as some prong brushes will (we've broken a lot of brushes!)  It is easy to hold.  Unfortunately, I couldn't give it 5 stars because my daughter has straight but wavy with curls at the ends hair and while it does detangle there was still plenty of "ouch mommy that hurts" from my 5 yr old.  That being said I have never found a brush that gets us through her hair tear free.

I purchased these brushes as gifts, one for my sister who has extraordinarily thick, wavy hair.  The other for my granddaughter, who has very, very curly hair. Both of them loved the brushes and have said that no previous hair tool has been as effective, nor as gentle as these. They report less breakage and faster hairstyling.  I am planning to buy a few more as gifts, including one for myself!

Over a year ago I purchased a brush which was shaped and looked like this one. It was called Curves. I have been looking for this brush and have now purchased 2 that look the same but cannot hold a candle to the original. The outside bristles on this brush bend and become misshaped after a few uses. I would not purchase this again.

I have to admit that I was very skeptical because I have long and thick  hair past my waist but  so far I am pleased with the detangling brush.  I love that it came with 2 brushes so that I could give one to my granddaughter.  So far, she is pleased as well.

These are amazing! I have a 3 year old and brushing her hair was a nightmare!! She would scream and throw a fit at every tangle. Got these brushes and it has completely changed! Not only is it faster but doesn't pull and hurt like a normal brush.

The bristles broke off the brush right out of the package, I rubbed my thumb over the bristles and they broke away like dead pine needles.  Poor quality. It fell on the floor and the purple top piece popped off..Oooh what a waste.

Before this product I didn't even realize they made a brush specifically for detangling. It definitely worked, the only downside is having to brush the same spot over & over & over. Otherwise a great product.

claims.text: Many reviewers say the brush effectively detangles hair, including for children and curly or thick hair.
A common complaint is that bristles or teeth break off or fall out quickly, even after only a few uses.
Several reviewers find the brush gentle and pain-free, though some report sharp bristles that cause pain.
Some reviewers describe the product as cheaply made and not durable, with handles or brushes breaking easily.
Reviewers frequently praise the brush's shape and ease of holding, though a few find it awkward to hold.
